lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 6-7 faint, high-contrast white vertical lines are visible across the torso; spacing is wider in the mid-torso region and narrower towards the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 4th and 5th lines (counting from anterior) are discontinuous, appearing as dashed segments that terminate in the mid-rib region.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns emerge with an outward lateral vector of approximately 40 degrees from the skull base, transitioning into a medial and posterior lyrate curve.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal horn tips is approximately 2.2 times the pixel width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping comprises approximately 10-12% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Long white dorsal crest along the spine; two distinct white spots on the cheek/infraorbital region; sharp color transition to tan/orange on distal limbs below the carpus and tarsus.
